from model_client import GeminiClient
from model_models import ModelPayload, ModelResponse

def answer_with_context(payload: ModelPayload) -> ModelResponse:
    client = GeminiClient()
    model = client.get_generative_model(model_name="gemini-pro")
    
    prompt = f"Context: {payload.context}\n\nQuestion: {payload.question}\n\nAnswer:"
    
    response = model.generate_content(prompt)
    
    return ModelResponse(text=response.text)

from typing import Generator
from model_client import GeminiClient
from model_models import ModelPayload, ModelResponse

def stream_completion(payload: ModelPayload) -> Generator[ModelResponse, None, None]:
    client = GeminiClient()
    model = client.get_generative_model(model_name="gemini-pro")
    
    prompt = f"Continue the following text: {payload.text}"
    
    responses = model.generate_content(prompt, stream=True)
    
    for chunk in responses:
        yield ModelResponse(text=chunk.text)

import os
from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate
from model_models import ModelPayload, ModelResponse

def translate_text_result(payload: ModelPayload) -> ModelResponse:
    # Ensure GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS is set for authentication
    # os.environ["GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS"] = "/path/to/your/keyfile.json"
    
    translate_client = translate.Client()
    
    text_to_translate = payload.text
    target_language = payload.target_language or "es" # Default to Spanish if not provided
    
    result = translate_client.translate(text_to_translate, target_language=target_language)
    
    translated_text = result["translatedText"]
    
    return ModelResponse(text=payload.text, translated_text=translated_text)

import os
from google.cloud import texttospeech
from model_models import ModelPayload, ModelResponse

def generate_spoken_brief(payload: ModelPayload) -> ModelResponse:
    # Ensure GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS is set for authentication
    # os.environ["GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS"] = "/path/to/your/keyfile.json"
    
    client = texttospeech.TextToSpeechClient()
    
    synthesis_input = texttospeech.SynthesisInput(text=payload.text)
    
    voice = texttospeech.VoiceSelectionParams(
        language_code="en-US", 
        ssml_gender=texttospeech.SsmlVoiceGender.NEUTRAL
    )
    
    audio_config = texttospeech.AudioConfig(
        audio_encoding=texttospeech.AudioEncoding.MP3
    )
    
    response = client.synthesize_speech(input=synthesis_input, voice=voice, audio_config=audio_config)
    
    return ModelResponse(text=payload.text, audio_content=response.audio_content)
